observability._note: nldesign adopts the OpenRegister AppHost observability engine (ADR-040) for its health endpoint only. nldesign is a pure NL Design theme app with NO OpenRegister dependency, so this block uses ONLY the OR-independent check types (database, filesystem, appEnabled) — no orAvailable, no OR-object metrics. The /api/health route is aliased to AppHost\Controller\GenericHealthController#index via a lazy service registration in lib/AppInfo/Application.php (the engine classes are referenced only as strings inside a closure, so Nextcloud still boots when OpenRegister is absent). The bespoke MetricsController (/api/metrics) is NOT adopted: it exposes nldesign's own domain metrics (token sets, custom overrides, theming syncs) which are the app's value, not boilerplate. PARITY: the deleted bespoke HealthController checked only token_set config presence; this declarative block is a documented improvement — it adds the standard {status, app, version} envelope plus real database/filesystem/appEnabled liveness checks. This is an observability-only manifest (schema v2.13.0 profile): nldesign renders no manifest-driven UI, so there is deliberately no menu/pages. NOTE 2026-07-06: the health config previously sat at top-level `health`, which the AppHost ManifestLoader never reads (it parses `observability.health`) — the declared checks were dead config until this fix.
